aggregation: Equal-weight matched-seed means within each target/condition; no dataset or target pooling
paired_run_policy: Average paired seed deltas within each positive-bearing run, then count one vote per run separately per operating point; zero-positive runs excluded

primary_screen.interpretation: All five descriptive gates required; no significance/population noninferiority guarantee. Secondary arms remain secondary irrespective of results.

semantic_event.selection: Lowest feasible strict threshold; calibration data only
limitations: Empirical event FPR, not a population guarantee or host-hour alarm rate
Dependent rows and distribution shift are not corrected by this selector
One-row budget resolution is not a confidence or power calculation
